what: Every Bundervoet person-mention found across all four venues swept on 2026-07-27, clustered conservatively.
clustering: Same folded forename AND at least one of: birth year within 1, death year within 1, same birthplace. Deliberately conservative - where two mentions cannot be told apart they are kept SEPARATE, because merging two different people is the failure mode this project is built against.
folded_into_data: The 272 clusters carrying two or more identifier types were checked against the 35 Bundervoet records already in the tree; 14 matched an existing person and were skipped, 258 were written as new person records, all `sup`, all unlinked.
deliberately_not_folded_in: 899 clusters carry fewer than two identifier types - 400 have a forename and nothing else. Writing them would put ~900 mutually indistinguishable records into the tree, which is precisely what tools/identify.py and the build-time blocking index exist to prevent. They are indexed here instead, and remain findable by name.
